detailed_description:
The target video is a high-contrast, photorealistic 3D game-cinematic wuxia style inside an emerald bamboo forest, with morning backlight, cold green grading, volumetric Tyndall beams, and no text or watermarks.
[Shot 1] An extreme wide shot of <Subject 3>: morning light pierces the canopy in Tyndall beams; <Subject 1> on the left and <Subject 2> on the right explode off the line as afterimages toward center, their swords meeting in an instant that bursts a ring-shaped air shockwave and flings bamboo-leaf debris; low angle, handheld tracking with a fast push-in, 24mm deep focus locked on the clash point; cold green, high contrast, strong backlight; extreme wind and a deafening metal clash roar.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, a medium close-up: <Subject 2> sits at the right golden-ratio point, thrusting his sword forward at extreme speed, the blade trailing a cold energy afterimage, eyes cold, robe tails streaming backward; over-the-shoulder fast dolly-in following the thrust, 50mm medium focus, background bamboo motion-blurred; side backlight chiseling his cold silhouette; a sharp blade whoosh.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.000, a close-up of <Subject 1>'s face and upper body, blade held across her front: she two-handed-catches the thrust and precisely parries, brilliant sparks and rippling energy bursting at the contact, hair streaming backward from the shockwave; rapid zoom-in with a slight impact freeze, 85mm shallow focus on her cold eyes and the hilt meeting; warm spark light against the cold green surroundings; a crisp sword ring and shockwave burst.
[Shot 4] At 00:04.500, a wide shot with height disparity and thick bamboo crossing frame: <Subject 1> deflects force, turns into a kick that drives <Subject 2> back, then springs off a bamboo stalk and launches into the air, the stalk instantly cracking and splinters flying; low-angle tilt-up following her ascent, 35mm medium focus; top morning light rim-lighting the flying splinters; a dull thud of the kick and crisp bamboo snap.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.000, a low angle: <Subject 2> in the lower frame slides back to evade while <Subject 1> descends from above in a spinning reverse slash, her blade passing an inch from his nose, water mist and mud split open by the sword qi; ground-level extreme low tracking his retreat, 24mm deep focus with foreground water droplets; cold green high contrast, blade glare lighting both faces; rapid scuffing footsteps and whipping fabric.
[Shot 6] At 00:08.000, an extreme close-up filling the frame with two crossed blades: the edges grind at high speed, sparks spraying, fine steel texture visible, the metal slightly bending under the force; locked on the contact with violent handheld micro-shake, 100mm macro extremely shallow focus; blinding spark highlights, crushed shadows; teeth-grating metal screech and a high energy whine.
[Shot 7] At 00:09.500, a high overhead drone view: the two become a red and a black light streak crossing mid-air, exchanging more than ten strikes in an instant, sword qi lashing out, swathes of bamboo sliced off, leaves falling like rain; drone fast spin-and-descend, 18mm wide deep focus; the frame dark overall, the trailing sword-qi streaks the main moving light source; continuous sonic booms and bamboo collapsing.
[Shot 8] At 00:11.000, a medium close-up dominated by <Subject 1>: after a landing roll she pivots without pause and unleashes a full-force horizontal slash, red sleeve and long hair arcing through the air; 180-degree high-speed orbital tracking around her with strong motion blur, 50mm shallow focus, the background dissolving into green streaks; hard side light outlining the tension of her strike; heavy breathing and a fatal sword whoosh.
[Shot 9] At 00:13.000, a symmetric medium shot: <Subject 1> stands while <Subject 2> is driven down to one knee blocking with his sword, the contact detonating a blinding hemispherical shockwave that instantly clears all leaves; camera shakes violently then freezes in bullet time, 35mm medium focus; the shockwave glares pure white, then the frame quickly cuts to black; a deafening boom followed by instant dead silence.

overall_soundscape:
Bamboo wind and leaf rustle underlie the fight; a deafening opening clash roar, a sharp thrust whoosh, a crisp parry ring and burst, a dull kick and bamboo snap, scuffing footsteps, a teeth-grinding blade screech and high whine, continuous sonic booms and bamboo collapse, a fatal horizontal slash whoosh, and finally one overwhelming boom dropping to total silence. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
a percussive martial arts score: war drum and tense strings exploding from the first frame, accelerating through the aerial exchange, a sweeping lyrical stinger on the woman's horizontal slash, then a final massive orchestral hit that cuts dead on the blackout. No vocals.
